title: COMP 3522 C++
subtitle: Week 1, preparing for Quiz 1
description: Everything Quiz 1 covers: C++ program structure, fundamental types, operators, casting, constants, and console IO. Each lesson has runnable code you can edit, visual explainers, and a self-check quiz. Finish with the mock quiz and the cheat sheet.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 1 format, from the slides
Written at the start of lab on the Learning Hub: multiple choice, true/false, matching. It covers the Week 1 slides **and the Week 1 sample code** (HelloWorld, AddIntegers, AddIntegersError, assortedOps, bits, const_vs_constexpr, precisionAndWidth, readName). Every one of those programs is reproduced, runnable, and explained inside these lessons.
:::

steps.note: take it cold first, so you know where the gaps are (about 30 min)
the manipulator table is the densest quiz material; play with the widget until every output is predictable
fail/bad/eof/good, clear + ignore, and why AddIntegersError breaks
pre/post ++ and short-circuit are the classic what-does-this-print questions
const vs constexpr is a guaranteed true/false pair
the hidden-subtract trick in the sample code
print it and read it on the way in
